 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Kuldeep Mathur
Order 17/01/2024

This application for bail under Section 439 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioner who has been arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.101/2023 registered at Police Station Hiran Magri, District Udaipur, for the offences punishable under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 and 120B of the IPC and Section 3, 6 & 9/10 of the Rajasthan Public Examination Act.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner so also the learned Public Prosecutor and perused the material available on record.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner has been falsely implicated in the present case.

Learned counsel submitted that the allegation upon the petitioner that he introduced co-accused Sanjay to one Sharwan Kumar and his role [2024:RJ-JD:2726] (2 of 3)
[CRLMB-15687/2023] is of extending logistic support to another co-accused Kishna Ram appearing in the REET 2022 Level 2 Examination as a dummy candidate in place of one Sanjay Pargi.

Learned counsel submitted that the co-accused persons namely Kishna Ram, Sharwan Kumar and Sanjay have already been enlarged on bail by this Court vide orders dated 02.05.2023 and 09.01.2024 Banshilal vs State Of Rajasthan (2024:Rj-Jd:2726) on 17 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/194076924/
1 respectively.

Learned counsel submitted that the petitioners are in judicial custody, challan has been filed and the trial of the case will take sufficiently long time, therefore, the benefit of bail should be granted to the accused- petitioners.

Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor has opposed the bail application and submitted that the petitioner is the main accused in the present case as he introduced co-accused Sanjay with one Sharwan Kumar.
Learned Public Prosecutor submitted that looking to the seriousness of the accusation against the present petitioner, he does not deserves to be enlarged on bail.

Having considered the rival submissions, facts and circumstances of the case, this Court finds that co-accused persons namely Kishna Ram, Sharwan Kumar and Sanjay have already been enlarged on bail by this Court vide orders dated 02.05.2023 and 09.01.2024 respectively.

This Court also finds that investigation against the petitioner has already been completed; petitioner does not have any criminal antecedents, thus, without expressing any opinion on merits/ demerits of the case, this Court is of the opinion that the bail application filed by the petitioners deserve to be accepted.
Consequently, these bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. are allowed.

It is ordered that the accused-petitioner [2024:RJ-JD:2726] (3 of 3) [CRLMB-15687/2023] Banshilal S/o Ganeshlal,
arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.101/2023 registered at Police Station Hiran Magri, District Udaipur, shall be released on bail, if not wanted in any other case, provided each of them furnishes a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand) and two sureties of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) each, to the satisfaction of learned trial court, for their appearance before that court on each & every date of hearing and whenever called upon to do so till completion of the trial.
A copy of this order be placed in each file.

(KULDEEP MATHUR),J 57-Hanuman/-
